title: Move the reminder bar
summary: Put the reminder icons wherever you like: unlock, drag, lock. The position is saved.

steps.say: /syb test shows a 20-second preview of every kind of reminder, so you can see where the bar sits.
/syb move unlocks it: a blue box appears over the bar.
Drag the box to wherever you want the icons.
/syb lock locks it in place. The position is saved: it survives /reload and logging out.
Prefer clicking? The same Move rows button is in the options window (/syb).
